_data_gaps.endTimes: Eventbrite cards expose start time only. end is null on all Eventbrite items.
_data_gaps.recurrence: Items with _repeatCount have an unknown frequency — resolve before seeding or they seed as single-date events.

Every lat/lng: drop each pin in Google Maps and confirm it lands on the right building or block
Hillcrest Car Show start time: a city listing showed both 12:00 and 13:00
Negociant event times and prices: confirm on their site
Farmers market anchor is 2026-09-06 — verify the market is still running that day
Geocode every item with _needsGeocode: true before seeding — null lat/lng will fail Appwrite validation
Resolve _repeatCount items into real recurrence rules, or accept them as single-date events
Cozymeal items anchor to 2026-09-01 (past) — set next occurrence or mark as timemark
cathaus-burlesque-2026-10-01 shares seriesId 'richs-cathaus-burlesque' with the Sep 3 row already in this file
Two items have no public organizer; host is null, not an empty string
'Hillcrest area' (upcycle-gathering) is Eventbrite's literal venue string — no street address published
DATA CONFLICT — never-too-late-2026-09-30: start is 2026-09-30 (Wednesday) but description says 'Sunday, September 13th, 4-7 PM'. One is wrong.
DURATION — golden-girls-2026-09-04: end is 2026-09-05T09:00 (15-hour span). Show ends ~21:00 or 22:00.
DOUBLE BOOKING — vida-2026-10-15-18-00 and karaoke-with-spencer-2026-10-15-18-00 both start 2026-10-15T18:00 at The Brass Rail.
RECURRENCE CONTRADICTION — brass-rail-new-wave-karaoke says 'every second Tuesday' but has Sep 1, Sep 8 AND Sep 15 instances. Only one can be right.

DOUBLE BOOKING AT EQ — reverb-2026-09-10-21-00 and reverb-detroit-techno-2026-09-10-21-00 share the same date, time and venue. The Detroit Techno edition is likely what Reverb was called that week — one of the two should be dropped.
locationName 'Main Stage' on karaoke-saturdays and disco-t-dance rows is a room inside The Brass Rail, not a venue — normalise to 'The Brass Rail' if desired.
COVERAGE — Brass Rail feed ends 2026-11-28. No December events. Sabados En Fuego stops after Sep 19 despite being listed as weekly Saturday.
